title: Rialto contract 1.0.0
description: Structure of a Rialto contract. Reference resolution and name uniqueness (K1.2, K1.3) are checked by generators, not by this schema.

include.description: The fragments of a contract over several files: paths relative to this document, with * and ** (K5).

externalRef.description: <source>#<location>: a JSON Pointer for openapi sources, table or table.column for sql sources.

typeRef.description: A contract type or shape name, or an external reference.

typeExpression.description: Scalar, named type, or one level of list, set or map.

uniqueItems.description: For a list<T>: no two equal elements (D3.8).

maxSize.description: For a binary: the largest size in bytes (K2.11).

mediaTypes.description: For a binary: the media types it may have, such as application/pdf or image/*.

immutable.description: Set at creation and never changed afterwards (L1.6).

requiredWhen.description: Per enum property of the same type, the members while which the property is not null (D3.6).

absentWhen.description: Per enum property of the same type, the members while which the property is null (D3.6).

minimumOf.description: Another property of the same type that this one is at least (D3.7).

maximumOf.description: Another property of the same type that this one is at most (D3.7).

transitions.description: The state property and the allowed transitions between its members (lifecycle L5).

sets.description: Properties the rule writes in the same write as its to member: now, actor or null (lifecycle L5.7).

emits.description: Events an operation can emit when it performs this rule (lifecycle L5.10).

via.description: For role actor: the authored seam that derives the value from the verified principal (S4.6).

uniqueItems.description: For a list<T>: no two equal elements (D3.8).

transition.description: The transition this operation performs, as <Type>.<rule>, or the rule the value at select in the request body names (lifecycle L5, L5.6).

from.description: For a delete: the states in which the entity may be deleted (lifecycle L5.9).

link.description: Adds or removes one link of a to-many reference (L6).

subject.description: The entity the operation addresses (R1.7), or the entity of the verified principal (R1.8).

maxItems.description: For output: list<T>, the most elements the response holds (R2.7).

\\..description: A path key has two names and declares from (M2.10).

version.description: This api# property carries the stored version of the entity (M2.9).

presence.description: A boolean flag: true when this source property was present in the input (M3.11).

computed.description: Per property, a read-only value computed in the read: count, the to-many property it counts (P2.13).

blobs.description: Per binary property, the authored blob store that keeps it and the columns of its key and metadata (P7).

unique.description: Properties whose values are unique together (P3.6).

route.description: A route path: segments of literal text or one {parameter} (presentation U5.3).

tabs.description: Views shown as tabs of this view, in order (presentation U5.10).

where.description: Filters the view always sends, with the signed-in actor as value (presentation U6.5).

actions.description: Actions offered on each row, with parameters from the row (presentation U3.10).

open.description: The view a row opens, with its route filled from the row (presentation U5.11).

link.description: The view the value links to, with its route filled from the value (presentation U5.11).

options.description: A choice of elements that fills the field with the identity of the chosen one (presentation U2.11).

values.description: Fixed values the action sends, per JSON Pointer in the request body (presentation U3.9).

parameters.description: For a row action: per operation parameter, its source, route.<name> or row.<path> (presentation U3.10).

viewCondition.description: When an action or field is visible or enabled: per property path, the enum members one of which it holds, or actor (presentation U3.11).

navigation.description: The menu of the application: its home view and entries (presentation U5.9).

verification.description: How a server verifies access tokens of this provider: locally (jwt) or by asking the provider (introspection, S6.4).

apiKeys.description: API keys of services (S6): per name the OpenAPI apiKey scheme and the authored lookup.

fragment.description: A fragment of a contract over several files: the sections it contributes (K5). Never info, sources or include.
